stories.title: Through Dak Prescott's eyes: The Cowboys QB breaks down a play and all he sees
stories.summary: From pre-snap to post-snap, Prescott processes dozens of elements before the ball leaves his hand and is caught for a 21-yard TD.

stories.title: Aces' Wilson wins 5th MVP, says she'll nix pregame ceremony to focus on Game 3
stories.summary: Las Vegas Aces center A'ja Wilson has won a record fifth WNBA Most Valuable Player award but said she will not participate in a pregame ceremony to receive her trophy because she wants to focus on Friday's Game 3.

stories.title: MLB eyes shorter regular season, expanding division series to best-of-7
stories.summary: Major League Baseball proposed shortening the regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029 and expanding the division series to best-of-seven in bargaining with players.

stories.title: Staley perplexed by Aikman's calls on Saints' D: 'They're not true'
stories.summary: New Orleans Saints defensive coordinator Brandon Staley took issue Thursday with comments made by ESPN analyst Troy Aikman during the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.

stories.title: Fever's Clark denounces online hate directed at 'good soul' Mitchell
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark said she has talked with Kelsey Mitchell since her teammate spoke about online hate she has received and the difficulty of playing with the Fever.
